scripts.dev: npm run build -w @8ball/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @8ball/shared && npm run build -w @8ball/client && npm run build -w @8ball/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @8ball/shared && npm run test -w @8ball/server
